Realmglass

A dashboard project for Minecraft servers.

Realmglass grew out of running my own Minecraft world. I wanted a dashboard for the server that could become a reusable project in its own right.

It’s one of the places where my interests in building tools, running infrastructure, and playing Minecraft overlap.
